description.value: The Alaska Highway Mile 0 Milepost in Dawson Creek marks the official southern terminus of the legendary Alaska Highway, one of the most iconic long-distance road routes in North America. For touring cyclists, it is a pilgrimage destination and a natural starting or finishing point for any northbound adventure into the Yukon and Alaska. The milepost anchors a heritage district that includes the Dawson Creek Visitor Information Centre and is the starting point for the city's self-guided Mile 0 Heritage Tour.

address.value: 800 Hwy 2, Dawson Creek, BC V1G 3V8, Canada

No specific amenity data (bike parking, washrooms, water) is available for the outdoor milepost monument itself from any evidence source.

enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: The Mile 0 Milepost is a real, permanently accessible outdoor landmark and a culturally significant destination for touring cyclists on the Alaska Highway corridor. It is actively promoted by Tourism Dawson Creek as a key attraction.
enrichment_extras.notes: The milepost is an outdoor monument with no staffed facility of its own. Amenity data (washrooms, water, bike parking) likely depends on proximity to the nearby Visitor Information Centre rather than the monument itself; a separate OSM record for the VIC would be the appropriate place to capture those amenities.
